CapacitySurgeProtection.description: Represents the surge protection configuration for a capacity. A capacity with no configured surge protection is represented by `state` set to `Disabled` with the threshold properties omitted.

state.description: The state of surge protection for background operations on the capacity. Additional SurgeProtectionState values may be added over time.

rejectionThreshold.description: The 24-hour background utilization percentage at which background operations are rejected. Present only when `state` is `Enabled`. Valid range: 15-100.

recoveryThreshold.description: The 24-hour background utilization percentage at which surge protection deactivates. Present only when `state` is `Enabled`. Must be greater than 5 and strictly less than `rejectionThreshold`.

UpdateCapacitySurgeProtectionRequest.description: The request payload for updating a capacity's surge protection configuration. Omitting a property leaves it unchanged. When `state` transitions from `Disabled` to `Enabled` on an unconfigured capacity, both `rejectionThreshold` and `recoveryThreshold` must be provided in the same request. When `state` is set to `Disabled`, the persisted threshold values are cleared.

state.description: Set to `Enabled` to enable surge protection or `Disabled` to disable it and clear the persisted threshold values. Additional `SurgeProtectionState` values may be added over time.

rejectionThreshold.description: The 24-hour background utilization percentage at which background operations are rejected. Valid range: 15-100.

recoveryThreshold.description: The 24-hour background utilization percentage at which surge protection deactivates. Must be greater than 5 and strictly less than `rejectionThreshold`.

SurgeProtectionState.description: The state of surge protection on a capacity. Additional `SurgeProtectionState` values may be added over time.

values.description: Surge protection is enabled and the configured thresholds are enforced.
Surge protection is disabled and no thresholds are enforced.
